shape_geometry_distribution.geometry_authority_histogram_note: One cell can contribute to multiple authority-type bins; these counts can overlap. Excess bins classify each cell once.
shape_geometry_distribution.geometry_excess_histogram_quantity: Per geometry-bad cell, worst bad physical-face error/tolerance minus1

shape_geometry_distribution.short_edge_definition: Among the union of q-bad or J-bad cells, count a cell once if any of its six cached metric edge lengths is below 0.9 or 0.5.
shape_geometry_distribution.surface_interior_note: Surface means at least one marked physical cell face. Interior does not imply all vertices are unconstrained; cells without a physical face can still be coupled to boundary moves.
